messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — v1.14 RC1 code freeze in ~2h (17:30 PT). Please avoid non-critical merges. If you need an exception, file it with /release-exception and ping release-approvers. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

kevin: copying — is the version-stamp step automated, or should I run `scripts/stamp_version.sh`?

maria: @kevin release-manager will stamp once changelog + PR list is finalized. If you already bumped package.json, leave a comment with `v1.14` and I'll include. Docs-only PRs usually allowed but still needs a quick smoke test sign-off. :white_check_mark:

olivia: small ask — license header bump in tooling repo. Docs-only but touches build. Can I get a waiver?

maria: @olivia please submit an exception with reason "license header-only" and attach CI run link. Tag @sam for smoke test approval. Most waivers granted if CI green and no user-facing changes.

olivia: filed: /release-exception 1755554321-olivia-license-bump, CI passed. @sam could you glance?

release-bot: AUTOMATED: Cutoff timer started for v1.14 RC1 — freeze at 1755555521. Current PR queue: 18 open, 3 awaiting review. Link: https://ci.internal/runs/8843 :robot_face:

sam: reviewing now, should be quick. If it's pure header, I can /approve in exception form.

aj: FYI I have a hotpatch for kv-cache quant that needs to land — low-risk, fixes perf regression. How to request expedited exception?

maria: @aj include the perf regression note, benchmark gist, and at least two approvers from eng-runtime + eng-releases. Tag @lisa for rollout sign-off. We prefer cherry-pick into rc branch if possible.

aj: got it. pushing cherry-pick PR now: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/8421

kevin: one more — when we do version-stamp, do we also tag docker images? Need to ensure CI pushes image with same tag.

maria: yes — release pipeline will create git tag and trigger the image build. If you have a manual image change, add `CI_IMAGE_OVERRIDE=true` note in PR description.

lisa: triaging exceptions. My policy: docs/tooling -> skip, runtime changes -> require perf signoff + canary. I'll review @aj's PR after CI.

sam: approved olivia's exception and marked as docs-only in the tracker. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks team. Final ask — if you touch changelog, add your entry under "Unreleased" with `- <component>: <short>` and I'll aggregate. Ping me for the stamp once entries are in.

kevin: done, added changelog entry and bumped package.json to 1.14.0-rc1.

maria: perfect. Freeze reminder in 30m. I'll post final stamp when window closes.

release-bot: REMINDER: 30m until v1.14 RC1 freeze (1755555521). If you're filing an exception, include approvals and CI link. :bell:

olivia: thanks all — will monitor in case anything else pops up.
